Game Overview

Horror Sniper Clown Ghost is a horror title where lost in a nightmarish forest, you are Sam, a sniper caught between monstrous creatures and freedom. With only your wits and rifle, track, aim, and shoot to survive while sawing through chains. Balance precision and strategy in this chilling first-person shooter where every shot counts toward your escape.
